title: Every active blocker of an item is reachable from agent words when more than eight are active
outcome: Every active blocker of an item is reachable from agent words when more than eight are active
acceptance: A bounded read lists the active blockers of an item beyond the focus cap, each with its selector and exact clear command, with exact total and omitted counts and a continuation that refuses when stale
The read changes neither focus, claims nor records, and never splits a selector or a command when rows are shed for size
